// diagnostic E2816

Jet.LiveNotOneRemoteCall

This `app.live` closure is not one call of an `app.Remote` endpoint: {found}.

What

This `app.live` closure is not one call of an `app.Remote` endpoint: {found}.

Why

A live query is keyed by the endpoint it calls and that call's encoded arguments, so its subscription, its cache and the readers that share it all name that one call; a closure that does anything else has no such key.

Fix

Make the closure's whole body one call, `remote.method(args)`, where `remote` names an `app.Remote<S>`, `method` is an `#App.SignedIn` or `#App.Public` method of `S`, and each argument's type derives `Encode` and `Decode`; or pass a named source, `app.live(source, args…)`.

Worked example
